extensionDescription.message: On iPhone Duo, header bars and images continue under Safari’s side controls, while text stays clear of them.
extensionDescription.description: The description of the extension, shown in Safari's extension settings.

popupSubtitle.message: Pages that reach under Safari’s side controls
popupSubtitle.description: Subtitle under the name at the top of the popup.

onForSite.description: Label before a website name, for the switch that turns Duofari on for that site. Example: “On for example.com”.

siteExcludedNote.message: Off by default for web apps that draw their own full-screen interface.
siteExcludedNote.description: Shown under the per-site switch on sites Duofari leaves alone by default.

sectionExtend.description: Section heading for what Duofari extends under Safari’s side column.

hintAllImages.message: Widens each one and trims a little from its top and bottom.

hintBreakout.message: Photos grow to the full width before you scroll to them. Text below them moves down.

settingLandscape.description: Label for choosing which side Safari’s controls are on when iPhone Duo is held sideways.

hintLandscape.message: Auto extends only background colors in landscape. Choose the side if you know it to extend images too. Pages can’t reach under controls on the left.

hintHoldSteady.message: Stops pages sliding sideways. Turn off to keep double-tap zoom and swiping back from the middle of a page; pages then slide back after you scroll.

copyDiagnostics.description: Button that copies technical details for a bug report.

footnote.message: Duofari works on the outer display, where Safari keeps its buttons in a column down the side. When iPhone Duo is open, Safari uses the full width and pages are left as they are.

copied.description: Button text after the diagnostics were copied.

statusUnsupported.message: Duofari can’t change this kind of page

statusUnsupportedDetail.message: It works on websites, not on Safari’s own pages, Reader or PDFs.

statusNoAccess.message: Duofari can’t see this site yet

statusNoAccessDetail.message: Allow it on all websites so it can extend pages as they open.

statusThisPageOnly.message: For now Duofari can see only this page. Allow it on all websites so it can extend pages as they open.
statusThisPageOnly.description: Shown when Safari let Duofari run on the open page only because the popup was opened, until the tab moves to another site.

actionAllow.description: Button that asks Safari for permission to run on all websites.

statusNotRun.message: Duofari hasn’t run on this page yet

statusNotRunDetail.message: Pages opened before Duofari was turned on need a moment, or a reload.

actionApply.description: Button that runs Duofari on the open page without reloading it.

statusExtended.description: $1 is a list of counts, for example “3 bars and 2 images”.

statusColumnLeft.message: Safari’s controls take $1 points on the left.

statusColumnRight.message: Safari’s controls take $1 points on the right.

reasonNotDuoDetail.message: Duofari only changes pages on iPhone Duo, beside Safari’s side controls.

reasonNoColumnDetail.message: Safari is using the full width of the screen. Fold iPhone Duo to use Duofari on the outer display.

reasonUnexpectedDetail.message: Safari’s side column isn’t showing next to this page.

reasonDesktopDetail.message: This page is laid out for a wider screen. Turn on “Also adjust desktop-layout pages” under More to include it.

reasonStartSideDetail.message: Pages can only reach under controls on the side where their lines end, so Duofari leaves this one alone.

reasonTransparencyDetail.message: Safari’s side column is opaque, so nothing under it would show.

reasonUnstableDetail.message: The page kept changing size as Duofari worked, so it stepped back.

reasonExcludedDetail.message: Turn it on above if you’d like to try it here.

reasonZoomedDetail.message: Zoom back out to see the page extended.

countBarsOne.description: Singular. $1 is the number of header bars or backgrounds extended.

countBarsOther.description: Plural. $1 is the number of header bars or backgrounds extended.

countImagesOne.description: Singular. $1 is the number of images extended.

countImagesOther.description: Plural. $1 is the number of images extended.
